target: Phase P02: governance and controlled relocation in the golden QGIS coordinate-audit example
python_runtime: Python 3.14.7 for governance; bundled Python 3.12.15 for QGIS Processing
crs_units: Input EPSG:4326, longitude/latitude in degrees. No reprojection or metric operation.
commands_executed: Installed python-qgis.bat -s -B with a scratch wrapper adding its bundled Processing module, running copied native_qgis_smoke.py before change, after change, and after rollback
expected_result: Read-only preview exposes three local imports; each QGIS run accepts 2 points, rejects 3, and reproduces both expected JSON outputs. Rollback restores original project file hashes.
observed_result: Preview exposed all three imports without writing. Five copied Python sources compiled after relocation. Both output files matched the committed expected JSON and were byte-identical across all three QGIS runs. Original and rolled-back copies of all 10 example files matched their starting hashes.
not_tested: Runtime verification for ArcGIS, WPF, Qt GUI and web GIS in P02
known_limitations: Synthetic example tests only the named Windows QGIS Processing runtime.
Structural inspection is bounded and resolves a subset of literal imports and build references.
source_changes: Example source, input data and execution package retained their starting hashes. The temporary copy was edited and rolled back.
provenance_licensing: Golden coordinate-audit source and its synthetic fixture from the existing MIT repository; installed QGIS used locally.
